steps.title: Choose a Program
steps.description: Browse our programs and find the one that fits your interests and qualifications.

steps.title: Prepare Documents
steps.description: Prepare necessary documents including academic transcripts, language certificates, and passport copy.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.description: Complete the application form and submit all required documents.

steps.title: Application Review
steps.description: Your application will be reviewed by the university (4-6 weeks).

steps.title: Admission Letter
steps.description: If accepted, you'll receive an admission letter from the university.

steps.title: Visa Application
steps.description: Apply for a student visa at the Chinese embassy or consulate in your country.
